# lutar-lean

**Machine-checked Lean 4 proofs of the Lutar Invariant.**

This repository is the formal companion to *"The Λ-Ouroboros Substrate: Four Machine-Verified Mechanisms for Governed AI Runtimes"* (SZL Holdings, Paper v12). It contains the Lean 4 + Mathlib formalisation of:

1. **Axioms A1–A4** — the four properties any Lutar-style invariant must satisfy.
2. **Theorem 1 (Uniqueness)** — under A1–A4, the invariant Λ_k is unique.
